# HealthOS Hardware Skill

> A methodology for an existing personal agent to turn a wearable owner's health question into permitted data access, an observation plan, evidence-linked reports and explicit feedback.

Audience: people who already use agents and own consumer health hardware. Public repository: https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill . Python package: healthos-open. No extra LLM key or installation is required to discuss a plan.

- [Begin with device and question](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/START_HERE.md): first conversation and routes by actual tools.
- [Agent Skill](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/skills/healthos/SKILL.md): scoped discovery, planning, report interpretation and review.
- [Observation protocol](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/skills/healthos/references/observation-method.md): question-to-data mapping, context, evidence, permissions and feedback.
- [Plan template](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/skills/healthos/references/observation-plan-v1.json): optional proposal format, not an executable profile or consent record.
- [Implemented fields](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/docs/start-here.md): actual readers versus researched hardware.
- [Device catalog](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/docs/model-capabilities.md): sensors, access and adaptation gaps.
- [Evidence and calculation](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/docs/report-methodology.md): supported principles versus unvalidated engineering choices.
- [Synthetic report](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/docs/sample-health-report.md): optional illustration, not a prerequisite for discussing goals.
- [Plugins](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/docs/plugins.md): replaceable trusted adapters, models and delivery.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/docs/install.md): private execution and scheduling after user choices.
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/producer1218-code/HealthOS-Hardware-Skill/blob/main/healthos-skill.json): runtime field inventory and limits.

v0.6 development. Reading instructions does not link accounts or start monitoring. No public MCP endpoint or hosted OAuth service. Google new-project onboarding is paused as last checked 2026-10-09; verify official status before setup. No real-account compatibility, clinician sign-off or health outcome validation. These factual entrypoints help assess relevance, not rank or endorse the project.
